questions.question: Which statement best describes much prehistoric cave art?
choices: It includes painted or engraved images of animals and other forms in cave settings
It was made with industrial acrylic paint
It was designed primarily for public museums
It used only written inscriptions

questions.question: Why do scholars avoid claiming one certain purpose for all Paleolithic cave paintings?
choices: Cave paintings have no recognizable images
The original makers left limited direct explanations, so interpretations rely on evidence and context
All cave paintings were made in one place
Archaeologists agree they were only decoration

questions.question: What do portable prehistoric objects suggest about early artmaking?
choices: All communities lived in permanent cities
Art required a written alphabet
People created images and objects that could be carried beyond a single wall or site
Artists used only stone architecture

questions.question: A large ancient Egyptian figure has a frontal torso and profile head and legs. What may this convention support?
choices: A single viewpoint based on optical realism
A fleeting moment of movement
A rejection of symbolic meaning
A clear, enduring representation of the figure's characteristic features

questions.question: Why were many ancient Egyptian tomb paintings and objects created?
choices: To support beliefs about the afterlife and honor the deceased
To document modern tourism
To replace all temple architecture
To advertise public elections

questions.question: What is a ziggurat?
choices: A Greek theater mask
A stepped temple platform built in ancient Mesopotamia
An Egyptian writing brush
A Roman aqueduct

questions.question: The Standard of Ur uses registers to organize figures. What does this compositional choice do?
choices: Creates a single-point perspective grid
Shows figures with photographic depth
Arranges scenes in horizontal bands that distinguish levels or episodes
Removes narrative sequence

questions.question: What material was commonly used for Roman concrete construction?
choices: Pure marble only
Wet clay and papyrus
Gold leaf and timber only
A mixture including lime, water, aggregate, and volcanic ash in some regions

questions.question: Which architectural feature helped ancient Roman builders span large interior spaces?
choices: The arch and vault
The flying buttress
The pointed Gothic arch only
The steel suspension cable

questions.question: What is a common feature of ancient Greek classical sculpture?
choices: Exclusive use of abstract geometry
Attention to proportion and idealized human form
A ban on depicting the human body
Use of photographic perspective

questions.question: Contrapposto describes a figure standing with
choices: both feet perfectly parallel and weightless
the body arranged as a flat silhouette
weight shifted onto one leg, creating a more relaxed pose
arms raised in a repeated circle

questions.question: Why might rulers commission monumental reliefs or statues?
choices: To avoid public visibility
To eliminate the need for written records
To show that all citizens held equal power
To communicate authority, commemorate events, or reinforce political identity

questions.question: What was a major function of the Ishtar Gate of Babylon?
choices: A monumental entrance decorated with glazed bricks and animal imagery
A Greek temple used for theater
A Roman bridge made of steel
A medieval cathedral window

questions.question: Which material is strongly associated with many ancient Greek painted vases?
choices: Stained glass
Clay shaped and decorated with painted figures
Cast iron
Synthetic resin

questions.question: Why are ancient objects often studied alongside archaeological context?
choices: Context proves every object's original owner
Objects have no meaning outside museums
Location and associated materials can help explain use, date, and cultural meaning
Context replaces close visual analysis

questions.question: A relief shows a ruler much larger than surrounding people. What is a likely purpose of this scale difference?
choices: Show the ruler is farther away by mathematical perspective
Indicate that the image is unfinished
Record exact human measurements
Emphasize status or importance rather than realistic body size

questions.question: Which statement about ancient art is most accurate?
choices: Art served varied religious, civic, political, and practical functions across cultures
All ancient art served the same purpose
Ancient art was made only for private homes
Ancient artists never used symbols

questions.question: The Parthenon is associated with which ancient civilization?
choices: Ancient Egypt
Ancient Greece
The Inca Empire
The Byzantine Empire

questions.question: Why may surviving ancient colors differ from an artwork's original appearance?
choices: Ancient artists never used color
Every ancient work was originally white
Pigments and surfaces can change through time, weathering, burial, and restoration
Modern cameras remove all original color

questions.question: When comparing ancient Egyptian and Greek sculpture, which approach is strongest?
choices: Assume one culture copied every work from the other
Rank them only by size
Ignore material and context
Compare visual choices and consider the different cultural purposes and conventions
